purpose: Teach: 備蓄/修繕/調印/共催/譲る/過労/堅実/組み込ん

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 災害用の備蓄、本部、十分か、確認した?
lines.en: Have you confirmed the disaster stockpile levels at headquarters?
lines.style: Efficient and direct. Quick rhythm, no softening. Eyes forward. Brief pause for answer — not waiting for elaboration, just the facts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議室の修繕、業者と、調整しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're coordinating with the vendor on the meeting room repairs.
lines.style: Straightforward, attentive. Calm delivery. Showing he's on top of it without overselling. Slight nod of acknowledgment embedded in the tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: パートナー企業との調印、今期中に、済ませたいね。
lines.en: I'd like to get the partner company agreement signed before the term ends.
lines.style: Clear intention. Warm but firm — not a question. Light emphasis on the timeline. The tone of someone setting direction they believe in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市役所と共催で、地域イベント、開きます。
lines.en: Yes. We're planning a community event with the city hall co-sponsorship.
lines.style: Engaged and positive. Slightly brighter energy — he's moved past logistics to something more collaborative. Forward momentum in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 譲る場面、譲らない場面、見極めが、難しい。
lines.en: Knowing when to give ground and when to stand firm — that's the hard part.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Slow, measured cadence. The tone of someone working through something genuine. Slight inward focus — thinking aloud with Kenji.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の過労を防ぐ仕組み、強化中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're reinforcing the systems to prevent staff burnout.
lines.style: Steady and reassuring. Showing he understands the weight of what she's saying. Not just reporting — confirming alignment on what matters.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 堅実な財務、当社の強みよね、本当に。
lines.en: Solid financial management has always been our real strength.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Warm, almost wistful. She's recognizing something she believes in. Slight softening at the end — genuine appreciation for what they've built.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。AIを組み込んだ仕組み、社内で稼働中です。
lines.en: Yes. We have AI-integrated systems running in-house right now.
lines.style: Close, insider tone. Confident without being showy. He's sharing the update with someone who will understand its significance. Calm and direct.
